faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Everything you'd want to know before reaching out.

items.question: What does IRFAtech mean?
items.answer: IRFAtech stands for Integrated Resources For Automation & Technology. We're a digital transformation partner founded by Mohammed Irfan, helping businesses, governments, and NGOs replace manual processes with connected digital systems.

items.question: Who do you work with?
items.answer: Small and mid-sized businesses across retail, healthcare, education, and distribution — plus governments, NGOs, and international organisations for field data collection. Mainly in India and Timor-Leste, with clients scaling globally.

items.question: What's Landflix?
items.answer: Landflix is our flagship SaaS platform for real estate technology and digital property management — both a product in its own right and proof of what our stack can build.

items.question: Is IRFAtech a registered company or a freelancer?
items.answer: IRFAtech is a founder-led technology consultancy. You work directly with the team building your system, not a sales layer between you and the engineers.

items.question: Where are you based?
items.answer: We operate out of Kolkata, India and Dili, Timor-Leste, and work with clients remotely worldwide.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Send a message through the contact form or WhatsApp. We reply within a working day and set up a free, no-obligation call to understand what you need.

items.question: Do you only build ERP systems?
items.answer: No — ERP is one of eight services. We also build AI/workflow automation, custom software, WhatsApp automation, CRM systems, business websites, mobile apps, and provide ongoing maintenance.

items.question: Is WhatsApp automation compliant with WhatsApp's policies?
items.answer: Yes. We build on the official WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API), so messaging stays within Meta's business messaging policies rather than unofficial workarounds.

items.question: Can I own the code and data?
items.answer: Yes. Custom builds are yours — the code, the database, and the systems it runs on. We're transparent about this in the proposal before work starts.

items.question: How do you price a project?
items.answer: A free consultation, then one written proposal with a fixed price and timeline. No hourly billing and no surprise invoices.

design.heading: Business systems
paragraphs: Business systems are the foundation: the ERP, CRM, and custom software that replace scattered spreadsheets and manual record-keeping with one connected source of truth.

We build on Odoo for ERP — inventory, billing, accounting, and operations in a single platform — and on Laravel and Vue.js for anything custom that off-the-shelf software can't cover. Every system is shaped around how your business actually runs, not a generic template you have to adapt to.

faq.heading: Questions and answers
faq.lead: The things clients ask before we start.

items.question: What does a project cost?
items.answer: Every engagement gets one fixed price, agreed before we start. No hourly billing, no surprises afterwards. The free consultation tells us what your project needs, and you get the price in one clear proposal.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: That depends on scope — a WhatsApp automation build ships faster than a full ERP rollout. The proposal names the timeline together with the price, so you know both before we start.

items.question: What happens with our current systems and spreadsheets?
items.answer: They stay in use until the new system is ready and your data has been migrated. We review what you're running today before the first call, so you get clear answers from the start.

items.question: Do you host and maintain the system for us?
items.answer: Yes, if you want that — or we can set it up on infrastructure you control. Either way, it's covered in the proposal before work starts.

items.question: Do we need to meet in person?
items.answer: It's not needed. Most engagements run entirely by phone, video, and WhatsApp. We work with clients across India, Timor-Leste, and worldwide, and time zones are rarely a problem.

items.question: Are you a company or a freelancer?
items.answer: IRFAtech is a founder-led technology consultancy — you work directly with the team doing the work, from the first call to the finished system. No sales layer, no account managers, no handoffs.

items.question: Can we make changes ourselves after launch?
items.answer: Depending on the system, yes — say so in the first call and we'll set it up for it. Otherwise, send us your changes and the support plan covers them.

items.question: Do you build large online shops?
items.answer: Large-scale e-commerce platforms aren't our focus — but ERP-backed inventory and billing, business websites, and everything else on our services list, we build. Tell us what you have in mind and we'll be honest about fit.

items.question: Is the system really ours?
items.answer: Yes. For custom builds, the code, the data, and the systems it runs on are yours from day one. You're never locked into IRFAtech to keep it running.

items.question: What happens if something breaks after launch?
items.answer: We stay reachable after launch, and the SLA-backed support plan covers monitoring, fixes, and updates — so issues get caught before they cost you time.
